Synopsis:
    Sterling recovered marginally after hitting a 3-week low, lifted by a yen rally that pressured the USD broadly. The yen surge reflects rising BoJ rate hike expectations. Oil eased ~1% to $95/bbl after Middle East tensions briefly spiked. UK gilt yields pulled back after reaching 2007 highs, though elevated yields remain a fiscal headache for PM Burnham ahead of an October budget. Markets are fully pricing a BoE hike by year-end and another by March. UBS remains constructive on GBP citing fiscal credibility, improving UK data, and potential short-covering.
